title: They're Lying Scumbags
description:
James Talarico and Stephen Colbert claimed that Trump and the FCC blocked their interview from airing. But CBS itself admitted that was never the case. The real reason? The FCC’s Equal Time Rule.

So why blame Trump? Why claim censorship? Because outrage drives attention, fundraising, and viral moments.
